nodes.label: AIDA Copywriting Formula
nodes.rationale: Attention-Interest-Desire-Action: Used for CTAs and closing slides. Template: '[Bold statement]. [Benefit detail]. [Social proof]. [CTA].' Evokes curiosity→confidence→urgency emotion arc.

nodes.label: PAS Copywriting Formula
nodes.rationale: Problem-Agitate-Solution: Used for problem slides and pain points. Template: '[Pain point]? Every [time frame], [consequence]. [Solution] fixes this.' Evokes frustration emotion.

nodes.label: FAB Copywriting Formula
nodes.rationale: Features-Advantages-Benefits: Used for feature slides and product showcases. Template: '[Feature] lets you [advantage], so you can [benefit].' Evokes confidence emotion.

nodes.label: Before-After-Bridge Formula
nodes.rationale: Before-After-Bridge: Used for transformation slides and case studies. Template: '[Pain point before]. [Desired state after]. [Your solution] is the bridge.' Evokes hope emotion.

nodes.label: YC Seed Deck Strategy
nodes.rationale: 10-slide pitch deck for raising seed funding from VCs. Emotion arc: curiosity→frustration→hope→confidence→trust→urgency. Slides: Title, Problem, Solution, Traction, Market, Product, Business Model, Team, Financials, The Ask.

nodes.label: Duarte Sparkline Pattern
nodes.rationale: Alternates between 'What Is' (current pain) and 'What Could Be' (better future) to transform perspective. Pattern: What Is→What Could Be→What Is→What Could Be→New Bliss. Pattern breaks at 1/3 and 2/3 positions create engagement peaks.

nodes.label: Sales Pitch Deck Strategy
nodes.rationale: 9-slide structure for closing deals with qualified leads. Emotion arc: connection→frustration→fear→hope→trust→confidence→urgency. Slides: Personalized Hook, Their Problem, Cost of Inaction, Solution, Proof, Differentiators, Pricing/ROI, Objection Handling, CTA.

nodes.label: Color Psychology System
nodes.rationale: Maps colors to psychological associations: Blue=Trust, Green=Growth, Red=Energy, Gold=Luxury, Purple=Creativity, Black=Sophistication, White=Purity. Includes industry-specific combinations and WCAG AA accessibility (4.5:1 contrast ratio).

nodes.label: Social Photos Design Workflow
nodes.rationale: 8-step workflow: Activate project management → Analyze requirements → Generate ideas → Design HTML files → Screenshot export via Chrome headless/Playwright/Puppeteer → Verify & fix → Generate summary report → Organize output. Platform-specific sizes from Instagram 1:1 to YouTube 16:9.

nodes.label: Slide Layout Decision Flow
nodes.rationale: 4-step decision flow: 1) What's slide goal? → Search layout-logic.csv. 2) What emotion? → Search color-logic.csv. 3) Content type? → Search typography.csv. 4) Break pattern? → Check position 1/3 or 2/3 → Use full-bleed.
